comments.author: yangheng95
comments.body:
Implemented and released in [v0.1.25](https://github.com/yangheng95/opencorvus/releases/tag/v0.1.25).

Both guides now include an opt-in Parallel Search configuration using the existing remote MCP transport with `streamable-http` and `oauth: false`:

- [English guide](https://opencorvus.com/mcp-servers/#parallel-search-optional-no-api-key)
- [中文指南](https://opencorvus.com/zh-cn/mcp-servers/#parallel-search可选无需-api-密钥)

Verified by loading the documented configuration through OpenCorvus in a fresh isolated project without saved credentials: discovered `web_search` and `web_fetch`, received 10 search results, and fetched the returned MDN page with useful content. Both calls went through the normal permission authority. The guide also covers anonymous Fast mode, lower free-tier rate limits, and waiting before retrying after a rate-limit response.

The integration remains optional and uses the existing implementation. Thanks for the proposal.
